label: post_outcome_diagnostic_not_alpha_validation

v15RouteAssessment.interpretation: The first V1.5 holdout did not produce a single High-priority base_horizon_convexity selection. Therefore this window cannot validate the new promotion route. It does show the route did not automatically promote a heavily absorbed finite-cycle ETC setup when cutoff-valid realized earnings evidence was still insufficient.

keyExpressionNotes: ETC both frozen direct expressions produced very large 60d excess, but cutoff-valid H1 realized earnings confirmation was not yet available and the direct names had already rerated sharply.

PV opportunity direction was positive at the basket level: Longi produced positive 60d benchmark excess while Tongwei was negative, reinforcing opportunity-first expression adequacy rather than exact peer ranking.
5G licensing did not produce positive 60d selected-company excess for ZTE, supporting continued caution on policy triggers without incremental order/earnings confirmation.

semiconductorLocalization.diagnosis: The basket included GigaDevice and Will Semiconductor, both of which had separate pre-cutoff transformative M&A/regulatory catalysts. Treating this as a pure generic-localization miss would be causally wrong.

memoryDowncycle.diagnosis: GigaDevice and Beijing Junzheng carried company/product/corporate-action theses distinct from generic DRAM/NAND pricing. This result diagnoses discovery/candidate-unit mismatch, not that falling DRAM/NAND was itself bullish.

crossWindowImplications.v15BaseHorizonConvexity: Needs another untouched window because 2019Q2 generated no eligible Primary route case.
crossWindowImplications.hypothesisGranularity: Still supported. Product and company-specific causal units must remain separated from broad industry baskets.
crossWindowImplications.corporateActionDiscovery: New candidate failure class. Issuer-specific transformative M&A/restructuring events can dominate returns while broad sector fundamentals remain weak.
crossWindowImplications.antiOverfit: Do not add GigaDevice, Will Semiconductor, Beijing Junzheng or semiconductor-specific exceptions. If implemented later, the rule must be a generic issuer-event discovery lane.

versionDecision.nextAction: Run unchanged V1.5 on another untouched historical window before altering promotion rules. Keep the corporate-action blind spot as a separately tracked future discovery candidate.
versionDecision.reason: Changing discovery and promotion simultaneously would confound attribution. V1.5's new route remains untested rather than failed.

prohibitedUses: Do not treat the 2019Q2 semiconductor/memory basket returns as proof that negative DRAM/NAND physical data should have been ignored.
Do not retroactively promote ETC using the July H1 guidance upgrade that was unavailable at the June 30 cutoff.
Do not add named-stock or named-sector exceptions.
Do not claim V1.5 is validated from a window with zero Primary selections.
Do not tune V1.5 using 2019Q2 outcomes.
